answer: Quarantined newcomer islands resist Sybil attacks: every new identity starts isolated on a small island with capped transaction rights, cut off from the main ocean of commerce. Passage to the wider economy requires a season of verified work plus a sponsor bond that is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Like a grove that only grows where the soil is proven, trust spreads slowly: an attacker must nurse a thousand quarantined fakes through real work and sponsor bonds before any of them can transact freely, turning a cheap flood into a slow, expensive harvest.
